📖 How to use

  1. Click inside the test box to focus it.
  2. Press any keys — key, code, keyCode, location and modifiers appear live.
  3. Review the history table or clear it to start over.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between key and code?

key is the character produced (affected by layout and modifiers), while code is the physical key position (e.g. KeyA) — code stays the same across layouts.

What is keyCode?

keyCode is a legacy numeric code (e.g. 13 for Enter). Prefer key and code in new code; keyCode is shown here for debugging older scripts.

Can I prevent default browser shortcuts?

Yes — tick preventDefault to stop the browser's default action, e.g. to test that Space does not scroll the page.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
